author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a ring-headed mast with two pairs of signal arcs; matches the reference. The rejected drawing had a solid dot head and crowded arcs.
omissions: None; the head ring is small (r3) so that two arc pairs fit with 8-unit gaps.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L symmetric about x 24: head ring r3 at (24,20), mast to y 40; inner arcs r12 through (15|33, 13..27); outer arcs r20 about the head through (8|40, 8..32).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'radio'/'antenna': mast with paired signal arcs.
